description: This file contains unit tests for the authentication hashing utilities in a software project. It verifies behavior for password hashing, verification, migration from legacy hash formats, tenant orgSalt management, and error handling in various scenarios.

methods.name: getPepper
methods.description: Retrieve the pepper value used in hashing, imported from authHash.

methods.name: hashPasswordV1
methods.description: Generate a legacy version 1 password hash from plain text.

methods.name: hashPasswordV2
methods.description: Generate a version 2 password hash, requiring tenant.orgSalt and optional pepper.

methods.name: verifyPassword
methods.description: Verify a password against a stored hash, considering hash version.

methods.name: ensureTenantOrgSalt
methods.description: Generate and persist tenant orgSalt if missing, ensuring unique salt per tenant.

methods.name: hashPassword
methods.description: Wrapper that defaults to v2 hashing, respecting tenant orgSalt and optional pepper.

methods.name: verifyAndMigrate
methods.description: Verify password for a user, performing hash migration from legacy v1 if needed.
